newsitem.title: USA: Plane crashes in Alabama, 3 reported killed.
newsitem.headline: Plane crashes in Alabama, 3 reported killed.

text.p: A small private plane crashed Monday in a residential neighbourhood and television reports said the three people aboard the plane were killed.
No one on the ground was injured, police reported. The plane, a Piper PA-34, crashed at 7:20 a.m. CST (8:20 a.m. EST), the Federal Aviation Administration and police said.
The wing of the plane clipped a tree, then hit the chimney of a house, local television reported. The plane then struck a second house.
"We think the plane might have been trying to land in this area," Birmingham police chief Johnnie Johnson said. "We don't know the cause. There might have been some engine spluttering."
A spokesman for the local coroner could not be immediately reached to confirm television reports of the three deaths.
The FAA spokesman in Atlanta said the plane was on its way to Pensacola, Fla., when it crashed "in an unknown circumstance."
